learning_outcomes.text: Students can name, characterize, and compare the necessity, objectives, and solution approaches of information management in the product development process.

Students know different strategies of product modeling and analysis and can apply them appropriately with reference to the product development process, and motivate their application in practical product development.
Students can explain and differentiate methods, IT tools, and process flows of computer-aided product development, and can give recommendations for their use in the product development process.

Students have an overview of modern approaches such as Virtual Reality technologies, Additive Manufacturing, Industry 4.0, and Digital Twin, can classify them in the context of product development, and explain underlying concepts of information processing and representation.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to computer support & management in product development
Types, structure, and basic architectures of CAx systems
Fundamentals and strategies of CAD modeling, product documentation, and structuring of product data
Data exchange and interface standards in product development
Selected methods and applications of simulation & optimization in product development
Visualization & Virtual Reality in product development
Fundamentals of Product Data Management and Product Lifecycle Management
Introduction and evaluation of CAx systems
teaching_methods: Digital provision of slides for self-study
assessment_rules: The module grade is based entirely on the written exam (60 minutes).
